Baritone.UseInventory: Lets the pathfinder use items from your whole inventory, not just the hotbar.
Baritone.Vines: Allows climbing up and down vines and similar climbable blocks.
Baritone.JumpAt256: Allows jumping at the world height limit of 256 instead of stalling there.
Baritone.WaterBucketFall: Automatically places a water bucket when falling from height to avoid fall damage.
Baritone.Parkour: Allows parkour jumps so paths can cross gaps instead of walking around them.
Baritone.ParkourPlace: Allows placing blocks mid-parkour jump to reach landings that are further away.
Baritone.ParkourAscend: Allows parkour jumps upward by one block, so it can climb steps and low walls.
Baritone.DiagonalAscend: Allows gaining a block while moving diagonally instead of stopping to line up.
Baritone.DiagonalDescend: Allows dropping diagonally instead of requiring a straight line into the gap.
Baritone.LegitMine: Only mines blocks it can actually see, instead of tunneling to ore through walls.
Baritone.LogOnArrival: Disconnects from the server as soon as the goal is reached.
Baritone.FreeLook: Frees your camera during pathing, so you can look around without stopping.
Baritone.AntiCheat: Turns on anti-cheat compatibility, moving slower but far less likely to be flagged.
Baritone.Strict-Liquid: Checks liquids strictly and avoids flowing edges so you don't get pushed off course.
Baritone.CensorCoords: Masks your coordinates in chat output and in the log.
Baritone.CensorCommands: Hides the commands it runs and shows only a placeholder in chat.
Baritone.ChatControl: Lets you steer the pathfinder through chat messages instead of typed commands.
Bot.Repeat: Maximum trades per merchant screen, 1 to 15; higher values farm faster.
Bot.AutoClose: Closes the trading screen automatically once nothing else can be traded.
Bot.TimeoutClose: Closes the screen after the set seconds so the bot never gets stuck in a menu.
Bot.AutoOpen: Automatically right-clicks nearby villagers within range to start trading.
Bot.AutoEat: Eats automatically when health or hunger falls below the set thresholds.
Bot.AnyFood: Allows eating any food when no golden apples or golden carrots are left.
Bot.DropTridents: Throws out the duplicated trident after each duplication cycle.
Bot.DurabilityManagement: Swaps the least damaged trident into the used slot before each cycle.
Bot.Inventory: Swaps items inside the inventory instead of hotbar slots, but needs it open.
Bot.AI: Lets the pathfinder handle digging sand while the bot only collects it.
Bot.Nuker: Instantly breaks the ring of sand around you without moving.
Bot.RedSand: Targets red sand instead of normal sand, for red-sand terrain.
Bot.GetScore: Sends duel invites itself to farm score instead of only accepting them.
Offhand.Safe: Only swaps a totem in when health is low or a nearby crystal could kill you.
Offhand.LethalCrystal: Counts crystals that could one-shot you as danger, so the totem goes in early.
Offhand.GapSwitch: Temporarily puts a golden apple in your offhand while you eat one.
Offhand.Always: Allows the offhand apple swap no matter what you're currently holding.
Offhand.Gap-Totem: Also allows the offhand apple swap while holding a totem.
Offhand.Gap-Sword: Allows the offhand apple swap while holding a sword.
Offhand.Gap-Pickaxe: Allows the offhand apple swap while holding a pickaxe.
Offhand.MainHandTotem: Puts a totem into a chosen hotbar slot and holds it for extra safety.
Offhand.Slot: Which hotbar slot, 1 to 9, holds the main-hand totem.
Offhand.ForceUpdate: Re-selects the slot every cycle even when that slot is already held.
Offhand.WithOffhand: Still prepares a main-hand totem even when the offhand already has one.
MaceGodPlus.APT: Hits sent per cycle, 1 to 20; higher stacks damage but flags you more easily.
MaceGodPlus.AutoMace: Master switch for automatic mace hits; off means the module won't swing on its own.
MaceGodPlus.Swap: Switches the mace into your hand before hitting and restores the old item after.
MaceGodPlus.BreachSwap: Prefers the enchanted, breach mace when several sit in the hotbar.
MaceGodPlus.CustomDelay: Uses a manual attack interval instead of following the vanilla cooldown.
MaceGodPlus.AttackDelay: Gap between hits in milliseconds, 50 to 3000; higher means slower.
MaceGodPlus.DisableInteract: Temporarily disables InteractTweaks so its placement actions don't steal your hits.
MaceGodPlus.AutoCrystalSync: Temporarily turns off the crystal bot so both modules don't fight over the same clicks.
NameTags.Died: Color used for dead players' names, with a toggle to disable the tint.
NameTags.Sneaking: Color the name turns when that player is sneaking.
NameTags.Rectangle: Background plate color behind the name; lower the alpha for plain text.
NameTags.DrawItem: Draws the target's held and worn item icons under the name.
NameTags.Enchantments: Shows abbreviated enchantment names and levels under each item icon.
NameTags.ForceBar: Forces the durability bar to show even when the client wouldn't draw it.
NameTags.EntityId: Adds the entity id to the name so identical names can be told apart.
NameTags.Scaling: How much the tag keeps shrinking past the set distance; higher makes it smaller.
AntiPiston.AutoOff: Turns itself off once no pistons or redstone are left nearby.
AntiPiston.OnlyHead: Only targets pistons at or above head height, ignoring the ones below.
AntiPiston.Redstone: Also breaks redstone dust and blocks so the signal source is gone.
AntiPiston.Repeater: Also treats repeaters and comparators as break targets.
AntiPiston.LeverButton: Also includes levers and all button types in the cleanup.
AntiPiston.InventoryPause: Pauses while an inventory screen is open so clicks don't conflict.
VisualRange.Join: Notifies you when someone enters your visual range.
VisualRange.Leave: Notifies you when someone leaves your visual range.
VisualRange.Enemies: Treats every non-friend player as a target worth reporting.
VisualRange.Nakeds: Also reports players with no armor, even when only friends are tracked.
VisualRange.PlaySound: Plays an experience orb sound along with each notification.
VisualRange.OnlyEnemies: Only reports enemies and skips ordinary players entirely.
NoSound.ArmorEquip: Mutes armor equip sounds so swapping gear stays quiet.
NoSound.Explode: Mutes explosion sounds, including crystals and dragon fireballs.
NoSound.Attack: Mutes weak, strong and knockback attack hit sounds.
NoSound.Throw: Mutes throwing sounds for pearls, eggs, snowballs and potions.
Fonts.Alternate: Fallback font used for missing glyphs; set it to null to disable.
Fonts.Shift: Vertical pixel offset applied to all custom-font text, -10 to 10.
Fonts.Translate: Horizontal pixel offset applied to all custom-font text, -10 to 10.
TextRadar.Double: Uses two spaces between fields so entries look more spread out.
TextRadar.Pops: Shows how many totems that player has already popped.
TextRadar.Red: Paints the totem count red so dangerous players stand out.
HoleSnap.AnyHole: Counts any non-air block as a hole wall, not just hard blocks like obsidian.
HoleSnap.CircleSize: World radius of the target circle in blocks, 0.1 to 2.5.
HoleSnap.Segments: Circle segment count, 0 to 360; higher looks rounder but costs more.
PlaceRender.TryPlaceBox: Outline color of the box shown when a placement didn't go through.
PlaceRender.TryPlaceFill: Fill color of the box marking a failed placement.
PlaceRender.NoFail: Hides the failed-placement marker and only animates successful ones.
LongJump.JumpSpeed: Horizontal speed kept after the jump, 0.1 to 3.0; higher flies farther but flags faster.
LongJump.InLiquid: Keeps boosting inside water and lava instead of pausing.
Tooltips.Shulker: Previews what's inside a shulker box in its tooltip.
Tooltips.Beehive: Shows bee count and honey level in the beehive tooltip.
ChorusControl.Confirm: Key that applies the held chorus fruit teleport and releases the stored position.
CoordLogger.Death: Copies your death coordinates to the clipboard and prints them.
Flatten.Cover: Skips spots that still have air above, so you don't seal your own head.
NoRotate.PositionAdjust: Cancels movement packets while clipped in a block so the server can't push you out.
Trails.Pearls: Draws a trail behind ender pearls while they fly.
PacketLogger.MoveFull: Print full move packets that carry position, look and on-ground flags together.
PacketLogger.MovePosition: Log position-only move packets so you can verify what the server receives.
PacketLogger.MoveLook: Log look-only move packets to spot rotation spoofing or position corrections.
PacketLogger.MoveGround: Log the bare on-ground move packet, handy for fall and fake-ground checks.
PacketLogger.VehicleMove: Log vehicle move packets with boat or minecart position and rotation.
PacketLogger.PlayerAction: Log player action packets such as start or abort break, with block side and position.
PacketLogger.UpdateSlot: Log hotbar slot switch packets to confirm silent switches were actually sent.
PacketLogger.HandSwing: Log hand swing packets and which hand triggered each one.
PacketLogger.Pong: Log Pong replies to server keep-alive probes for latency observation.
PacketLogger.InteractEntity: Log entity attack and interact packets with target name and entity id.
PacketLogger.InteractBlock: Log block interact packets with position, face and hand.
PacketLogger.InteractItem: Log item use packets such as eating, drinking and throwing.
PacketLogger.ClientCommand: Log client command packets for sprint, sneak and elytra start.
PacketLogger.ClientStatus: Log client status packets like respawn requests and stats.
PacketLogger.ClickSlot: Log slot click packets with action type, slot and button.
PacketLogger.PickInventory: Log pick-from-inventory packets used by auto pickup routines.
PacketLogger.TeleportConfirm: Log teleport confirm packets to verify lagback handling.
PacketLogger.S2cVelocity: Log incoming knockback and explosion velocity with all three components.
HUD.RenderingUp: Stack info lines from the top while the module list grows from the bottom.
HUD.LowerCase: Force every HUD label and value to render in lowercase.
HUD.EnableLength: Expand animation time in ms; 0 snaps instantly, higher slides in slower.
HUD.DisableLength: Collapse animation time in ms; higher makes entries shrink away slower.
HUD.FadeLength: Fade in and out time in ms; higher gives a softer transition.
HUD.ArrayList: Show the list of currently enabled modules on screen.
HUD.ListSort: Sort entries by text width so longer names sit on top.
HUD.ArmorOffset: Distance of the bottom armor row from the screen edge, 0–100.
HUD.WaterMark: Draw the client watermark text in the top-left corner.
HUD.FPS: Add the current frame rate to the info column.
HUD.TPS: Show server ticks per second to spot a lagging server.
HUD.IP: Show the address of the server you are connected to.
HUD.Brand: Show the server brand such as Paper or Spigot.
HUD.Coords: Show your own coordinates at the bottom, with nether conversion included.
HUD.ColorSync: Tint the coordinate line with the HUD theme color instead of a fixed color.
HUD.BGColor: Background color behind each module entry, visible only when the background is on.
PistonCrystal.NoEating: Pause the whole combo while you are eating or drinking.
PistonCrystal.EatingBreak: Keep breaking crystals under the target even while eating.
PistonCrystal.Fire: Run the fire step, igniting the crystal spot with flint and steel.
PistonCrystal.Switch: Pick the next best piston spot once the current one turns to air.
PistonCrystal.MovingPause: Stop working while you move and resume once you stand still.
PistonCrystal.Stage: Total steps per cycle, 1–10; more steps split the combo finer.
PistonCrystal.PistonStage: Step number where the piston gets placed, 1–10.
PistonCrystal.PistonMaxStage: Last step for piston placement, forming a range with the start step.
PistonCrystal.PowerStage: Step number where the redstone block gets placed.
PistonCrystal.PowerMaxStage: Step where powering ends and no more redstone is placed.
PistonCrystal.CrystalStage: Step number where the end crystal gets placed.
PistonCrystal.CrystalMaxStage: Step number where crystal placement stops for this cycle.
PistonCrystal.FireStage: Step number where the flint and steel fire starts.
PistonCrystal.FireMaxStage: Step where the ignition action ends for this cycle.
FakeFlight.DownPitch: Pitch used when sneaking in place, 90 being straight down.
FakeFlight.MoveUpPitch: Pitch while moving and holding jump, negative climbs upward.
FakeFlight.MoveDownPitch: Pitch while moving and sneaking, positive dives downward.
FakeFlight.MovePitch: Pitch when only moving, near 0 keeps you level.
FakeFlight.MaxDelay: Longest gap between rockets in ms, larger saves fireworks.
FakeFlight.MinDelay: Shortest gap for an early rocket once speed drops below the threshold.
FakeFlight.SlowPass: Speed below this value counts as too slow and triggers a rocket.
FakeFlight.CheckFly: Confirm gliding is actually active before firing so rockets aren't wasted.
FakeFlight.ControlMove: Take over movement input in flight along with freeze and motion.
FakeFlight.StrictStartFly: Use stricter checks before restarting fake flight, sending fewer packets.
FakeFlight.SyncInv: Sync the inventory after swapping the elytra to avoid desync.
AntiPacket.Decode: Lift the inbound packet size cap so oversized packets still decode.
AntiPacket.Lerp: Snap straight to the corrected position instead of interpolating.
AntiPacket.S2CSlot: Block the server's slot change and resend your own slot.
AntiPacket.S2CRotate: Block server rotation fixes while still accepting position changes.
AntiPacket.ApplyYaw: Apply the server's rotation in the resent move packet instead of your own.
AntiPacket.S2CCloseScreen: Block forced screen closes while in a container so the GUI stays open.
AntiPacket.S2CInventory: Ignore incoming inventory contents so local items are not overwritten.
AntiPacket.AutoSync: Periodically resend a slot sync packet to keep both sides aligned.
Skybox.Horizon: Color of the nebula ring that sits on the horizon.
Skybox.Nebula1: Color of the outer nebula layer, which rotates slowly.
Skybox.Nebula2: Color of the inner nebula, spinning twice as fast.
Skybox.UVStars1: Color of the first textured star sprite layer.
Skybox.UVStars2: Color of the second textured star layer rotating on another axis.
Skybox.Stars1: Color of the first set of solid point stars.
Skybox.Stars2: Color of the second, sparser and brighter point star set.
Skybox.Stars: Toggle every star layer, leaving only nebula when off.
Criticals.SetNoGround: Force every move packet to report not on ground so the server thinks you are airborne.
Criticals.BlockCheck: Skip the jump when a block sits overhead so you don't bump it.
Criticals.Mini: Use a tiny upward motion instead of a real jump.
Criticals.MotionY: Upward motion for the mini jump, 0–1, higher lifts more.
Criticals.CrawlingDisable: Turn the module off automatically while you are crawling.
Criticals.Flight: Zero out vertical motion on landing so you stay glued to the ground.
BackPackHUD.Enable: Toggle whether the backpack preview panel is drawn.
BackPackHUD.ShowCount: Overlay the stack count on each slot of the preview.
BackPackHUD.Border: Draw an outline frame around the whole panel.
BackPackHUD.BorderColor: Color and alpha applied to the panel's frame lines.
BackPackHUD.BorderPadding: Gap between the frame and the slots, 0–10.
AutoPush.YawDeceive: Snap your yaw to the push direction before placing to fool facing checks.
AutoPush.PowerPacket: Place the power block by packet without swinging your arm.
AutoPush.AllowWeb: Still act on targets that are stuck in cobwebs.
AutoPush.SurroundCheck: Block count around the target needed to count as surrounded, 0–4.
NoSlow.SoulSand: Stop soul sand from dragging your movement down.
NoSlow.Climb: Let you climb against blocks like a ladder.
NoSlow.Gui: Keep walking while a container or GUI is open.
NoSlow.GuiMoveBypass: Disguise slot clicks made while moving in a GUI, pick per anti-cheat.
NoSlow.GuiMoveBypass=None: Send slot clicks exactly as-is with no disguise at all.
NoSlow.GuiMoveBypass=NCP: Resend a sprint start after each click to slip past NCP checks.
NoSlow.GuiMoveBypass=NCP2: Lift position by a hair and stop sprinting before the click.
NoSlow.GuiMoveBypass=Grim: Close the screen on non-pickup clicks to dodge Grim's GUI check.
NoSlow.GuiMoveBypass=Delay: Buffer clicks and flush them all when the screen closes.
AntiPhase.CollideSkip: Skip targets already stuck inside blocks to avoid wasted placements.
AntiPhase.CrawlingSkip: Ignore targets that are crawling on the ground.
AntiPhase.InAirSkip: Skip targets that are airborne and only handle grounded ones.
Step.OnlyMoving: Only raise step height while moving, restoring vanilla when standing.
Step.SurroundPause: Step aside while the surround module is running to avoid conflicts.
Step.PathingPause: Leave step height alone while Baritone is pathing.
PopChams.ForceSneak: Force the leftover model into a sneaking pose.
PopChams.NoSelf: Skip the ghost model when you pop your own totem.
PopChams.NoLimb: Render only the body of the ghost, without limbs.
SafeWalk.Legit: Brake by faking sneak, more human but slightly slower.
SafeWalk.OnlyInsideBlock: Only work while your body is inside a block.
TotemParticle.VelocityXZ: Horizontal spread speed of totem particles, from 0 to 500 percent.
TotemParticle.VelocityY: Vertical speed of totem particles, 0–500%, higher shoots up more.
FakeName.Names: Comma separated names to mask with asterisks wherever they show up in chat.
ExtraTab.Columns: How many columns the player list uses, 1–100.
Fly.VerticalSpeed: Vertical flying speed, 0.1–5, higher climbs and descends faster.
Replenish.ForceDelay: Refill interval in seconds once the count drops below ForceMin.
Trajectories.Arrow: Color of the trajectory line for arrows in flight, off hides it.
AntiPiston.Mode=Instant: Snaps to the block and sends destroy packets instantly to break it at once.
AntiPiston.Mode=Mine: Hands the target block to PacketMine and breaks it packet by packet, slower but stealthier.
Criticals.Mode=UpdatedNCP: Sends a tiny rise and fall position packet before each hit to fool NCP's fall check.
Criticals.Mode=Strict: Sends three gradually rising then falling position packets so crits trigger even under strict checks.
Criticals.Mode=NCP: Lifts you 0.0625 blocks and drops back with just two position packets to trigger a crit.
Criticals.Mode=OldNCP: Uses three ultra-small upward position packets to fake a fall against old NCP.
Criticals.Mode=Hypixel2K22: Sends a multi-stage rising position sequence to bypass Hypixel's 2022 crit checks.
Criticals.Mode=Packet: Sends only two tiny upward position packets, the lightest packet-based crit method.
Criticals.Mode=Ground: Auto-jumps and rewrites the on-ground flag on move packets to crit at touchdown.
Criticals.Mode=BBTT: Only while standing still, sends a grounded then rising position packet; moving cancels it.
FlatGroundMace.Mode=Vanilla: Lifts the packet position by the spoof height, fakes a full fall, then instantly attacks.
FlatGroundMace.Mode=DoublePacket: Sends a burst of anchor position packets to fake a fall, then lands the attack after a delay.
FlatGroundMace.Mode=VerticalSplit: Rises in small SplitStep increments each tick, spreading the fake fall across several packets.
FlatGroundMace.Mode=Hybrid: Fires six rising packets at the moment of attack, snaps back, then hits immediately.
FlatGroundMace.Mode=BlinkBuffer: Buffers all movement packets once you start falling, then releases them after a short delay.
FlatGroundMace.Mode=MotionSpoof: Pushes your position up 0.42 blocks per tick until it reaches the set height.
FlatGroundMace.Mode=TheVoid: Teleports your position up to the set height and attacks the target right away.
FlatGroundMace.Mode=VoidMace: Sends a rising position packet and syncs your client position to launch you high up.
FlatGroundMace.Mode=TP: Moves you up to the set height on the client only, without sending any packet.
MacePlus.Mode=WindJump: After using the wind charge, applies upward velocity to launch you into the air.
MacePlus.Mode=Forward: Applies horizontal velocity along your facing to push you forward.
MacePlus.Mode=Smash: Applies downward velocity so you drop straight onto the target below.
Clip.Mode=HitboxDesync: Offsets your hitbox 0.2 blocks along your facing, then disables itself.
Clip.Mode=Clip: While standing still, nudges your position and sends grounded packets to slip block by block.
Clip.Mode=NoPacket: Cancels your movement packets and only sends fake offset positions so the server never pulls you back.
MaceSpoof.Mode=Vanilla: Before the hit, sends four ground packets then a fake high fall to boost mace damage.
MaceSpoof.Mode=NCP: Rewrites the on-ground flag of every move packet so the server thinks you are falling.
MaceSpoof.Mode=Swap: Silently swaps to the mace slot before the attack packet, then swaps back.
MaceSpoof.Mode=SwapVanilla: Swaps to the mace, sends fake height position packets, then releases the real attack.
MaceSpoof.Mode=Bounce: Fakes a landing after each hit to reset fall distance so the mace bonus keeps triggering.
Phase.Mode=Pearl: Throws an ender pearl at a computed angle into the block to phase through it.
AnimatedGif.Mode=cat: Loops the cat.gif animation from the gif folder on screen.
AnimatedGif.Mode=kou: Loops the kou.gif animation from the gif folder on screen.
AnimatedGif.Mode=kiss_cum: Loops the kiss_cum.gif animation from the gif folder on screen.
AnimatedGif.Mode=shazi: Loops the shazi.gif animation from the gif folder on screen.
AntiAim.Mode=Spin: Continuously rotates your server-side yaw at the set speed to throw off aimbots.
AntiAim.Mode=Back: Locks your yaw 180 degrees behind you so aimbots track the wrong way.
AntiAim.Mode=Random: Picks a random yaw every tick so opponents cannot predict where you face.
Bot.Mode=AutoTrade: Walks to the nearest villager, opens the trade screen and repeatedly buys whitelisted offers before closing it.
Bot.Mode=ItemFrameDupe: Alternately places shulker boxes on nearby item frames and hits them to duplicate items.
Bot.Mode=XinDupe: Loots shulkers for eggs and hay, summons and tames a llama, fills its chest and then kills it.
Bot.Mode=NPlusOneDupe: Places blocks at the position PacketMine is breaking to trigger the duplication.
Bot.Mode=TridentDupe: Keeps throwing tridents and swapping or dropping slots to duplicate items through packet timing.
Bot.Mode=TurtlePath: Paths to the nearest adult turtle with Baritone and feeds it seagrass to breed.
Bot.Mode=Turtle: Only feeds seagrass to adult turtles within three blocks without any pathing.
Bot.Mode=SandMiner: Mines sand, crafts shovels and fills shulkers, switching to a sword when Aura has a target.
Bot.Mode=ScoreFarmer: Sends and accepts duels automatically, then suicides during the countdown to farm score.
Bot.Mode=SlabPlacer: Places slabs on top of nearby blocks in bulk and pauses while you are using an item.
Bot.Mode=Ominous: Switches to an ominous bottle and holds use on a timer, then restores your previous slot.
Bot.Mode=None: Does nothing at all, leaving the module effectively turned off.
ElytraFly.Mode=Control: Lets you steer the glide with pitch and the up or down keys while capping horizontal speed.
ElytraFly.Mode=Boost: Adds extra speed along your facing when holding forward, scaled by the Boost slider.
ElytraFly.Mode=Bounce: Locks the pitch and keeps refreshing elytra flight so you bounce along the ground.
ElytraFly.Mode=Freeze: Freezes all movement while idle, letting you hover in place in midair.
ElytraFly.Mode=None: Leaves movement and pitch untouched, keeping vanilla elytra gliding behavior.
ElytraFly.Mode=Rotation: Rewrites pitch from the jump and sneak keys and locks your yaw during level flight.
ElytraFly.Mode=Pitch: Oscillates the pitch automatically to keep your speed between the configured limits.
FastFall.Mode=Fast: Pushes your vertical motion down every tick on the ground for a faster drop.
FastFall.Mode=None: Leaves vertical motion alone and keeps only the timer speedup behavior.
FastWeb.Mode=Vanilla: Slides you straight down fast while sneaking inside cobwebs.
FastWeb.Mode=Strict: Speeds up the game timer instead of motion, making everything in webs faster.
FastWeb.Mode=Custom: Cancels vanilla cobweb slowdown and applies your own horizontal and vertical slowdown factors.
FastWeb.Mode=Ignore: Removes cobweb slowdown entirely so you move through it like plain air.
LongJump.Mode=Plain: Uses the higher horizontal multiplier to stretch each jump as far as possible.
LongJump.Mode=GrimHop: Jumps with a lower multiplier, using a slower speed that slips past Grim checks.
NoSlow.Mode=Vanilla: Sends no extra packets and only removes the item-use slowdown on your client.
NoSlow.Mode=NCP: Resends the held-slot packet every tick while using, bypassing NCP slowdown checks.
NoSlow.Mode=Grim: Resends the use packet on the other hand while eating to fool Grim's slowdown.
NoSlow.Mode=GrimPacket: Clicks a container slot first, then reuses the item on the other hand to confuse Grim.
NoSlow.Mode=Drop: Sends a drop packet alongside food use so the server ends the using state early.
NoSlow.Mode=None: Sends no bypass packets, so item use still slows you down like vanilla.
PacketFly.Mode=Setback: Sends a single move packet each tick and accepts server setbacks instead of fighting them.
PacketFly.Mode=Fast: Sends one move packet per tick and cancels setbacks for a steady, fast flight.
PacketFly.Mode=Factor: Repeats move packets up to the Factor amount within one tick for multiplied speed.
PacketFly.Mode=Slow: Also repeats move packets but accepts setbacks, which keeps you from getting kicked.
PacketFly.Mode=Increment: Raises the multiplier by one each tick and resets, stepping the speed up gradually.
PacketFly.Mode=Compatibility: Does no packet work at all, leaving movement to vanilla and keeping only noclip.
Speed.Mode=Strafe: Rebuilds speed each hop with staged acceleration and keeps momentum smooth after landing.
Speed.Mode=StrafeStrict: Applies faster staged acceleration under tighter speed caps, pausing when airborne or lagging.
Speed.Mode=Grim: Gains extra push from colliding with entities and boat hops to slip past Grim's speed checks.
Sprint.Mode=PressKey: Holds the sprint key for you, behaving exactly like a manual key press.
Sprint.Mode=Legit: Only sprints while moving forward and facing roughly the same way, staying human-like.
Sprint.Mode=Rage: Sprints whenever you move in any direction, ignoring facing entirely.
Sprint.Mode=Rotation: Silently rotates your view toward the movement direction so any direction keeps sprinting.
Step.Mode=Vanilla: Raises vanilla step height so you walk up blocks natively without sending any packets.
Step.Mode=OldNCP: Sends two gradual position packets to fake the step, staying under old NCP checks.
Step.Mode=NCP: Adds the final height as a third packet and time-scales it so NCP accepts the step.
VClip.Mode=Glitch: Sends a run of small downward position packets to squeeze you through the floor.
VClip.Mode=Teleport: Jumps you up three blocks and confirms with one ground packet, popping through ceilings.
VClip.Mode=Jump: Mimics a jump arc with position packets before raising you, clipping one block up.
Velocity.Mode=Plain: Simply scales knockback down by your percentages, the least server-dependent option.
Velocity.Mode=Grim: Only kicks in on obsidian or inside blocks, then sends position packets Grim accepts.
Velocity.Mode=Wall: Requires you to be inside a block, phasing through it to fool Grim's wall checks.
Velocity.Mode=None: Leaves knockback untouched and keeps only the liquid, entity and block push toggles.
ChestStealer.Mode=Steal: Shift-clicks every slot so the items move straight into your inventory.
ChestStealer.Mode=Drop: Throws each whole stack onto the ground, handy for emptying someone's chest.
NoFall.Mode=Packet: Silently flips the on-ground flag in your movement packets once you fall past the set distance.
NoFall.Mode=Grim: Sends a nearly in-place landing packet each tick and resets fall distance to fool Grim.
Replenish.Mode=QuickMove: Shift-clicks matching stacks from your inventory into the hotbar in a single move.
Replenish.Mode=ClickSlot: Picks up and places stacks step by step so the exact hotbar slot gets refilled.
ESP.Mode=ThreeD: Draws three-dimensional boxes around entities and containers that show through walls.
ESP.Mode=TwoD: Projects targets onto the screen as flat 2D boxes with optional health and armor bars.
PlaceRender.Mode=Fade: Keeps the box in place and just fades its outline away after placement.
PlaceRender.Mode=Shrink: Keeps the outline opaque while it contracts from a full block toward its center.
PlaceRender.Mode=All: Fades and shrinks at the same time for a full dissolve effect.
Shader.Mode=Solid: Fills the target with one flat color and adds a soft glow halo, with no animation.
Shader.Mode=Pulse: Breathes the tint back and forth between two colors with a radial glow.
Shader.Mode=Smoke: Overlays slowly drifting cloud noise that blends three colors together like smoke.
Shader.Mode=Gradient: Runs flowing noise blobs across the model for a soft animated gradient.
Shader.Mode=Snow: Scatters fine snowflakes that drift downward across the target.
Shader.Mode=Flow: Uses domain-warped noise to create rippling liquid or aurora-like color currents.
Shader.Mode=Rainbow: Sweeps a moving rainbow spectrum vertically across the whole target.
BlockLag.LagMode=Smart: Finds the nearest open air block and sends it, using the position mismatch to earn a server setback.
BlockLag.LagMode=Invalid: Spams twenty position packets 1337 blocks above you so the impossible height forces a setback.
BlockLag.LagMode=TrollHack: Sends one packet about 2.3 blocks up, using a fake jump apex to trigger the setback.
BlockLag.LagMode=ToVoid: Teleports your packet position to Y minus 70 in the void so the server yanks you back up.
BlockLag.LagMode=CuiCan: Drops the fake position down by the configured height, imitating a fall into a hole to force a setback.
BlockLag.LagMode=ToVoid2: Sends a fake position at Y minus 7 deep underground, trading an out-of-range spot for a setback.
BlockLag.LagMode=Normal: Sends a single packet 1.9 blocks up, imitating an ordinary jump to trigger the setback.
BlockLag.LagMode=Rotation: Sends two packets with impossible plus or minus 90 degree pitch, using an illegal rotation to force a setback.
BlockLag.LagMode=Fly: Sends a rising chain of position packets that looks like flying upward, forcing the server to pull you back.
BlockLag.LagMode=Glide: Sends a few packets wobbling around 1.1 blocks, mimicking glide height to trigger a setback.
MaceAura.LagMode=Fly: Lifts you to the configured height with jump packets, then drops back in place to fake a vertical flight.
MaceAura.LagMode=Smart: Slides a short distance toward the target, then up and down, pushing the fake position near them to spoof range.
32KMace.LagMode=Smart: Finds the nearest open air block and sends it, using the position mismatch to earn a server setback.
32KMace.LagMode=Invalid: Spams twenty impossible packets 1337 blocks high, forcing the server to setback you.
32KMace.LagMode=TrollHack: Sends one packet 2.34 blocks up, a fake jump that makes the server setback you.
32KMace.LagMode=ToVoid: Puts the packet position at Y minus 70 in the void and lets the server drag you back.
32KMace.LagMode=ToVoid2: Sends a position at Y minus 7 underground, trading an invalid spot for a setback.
32KMace.LagMode=Normal: Sends one packet 1.9 blocks up, the height of a normal jump, to trigger the setback.
32KMace.LagMode=Rotation: Sends two packets looking straight up and down, using illegal pitch to force a setback.
32KMace.LagMode=Fly: Sends one packet at the configured fly height, faking a hover to trigger the setback.
32KMace.LagMode=Glide: Sends several packets jittering near 1.1 blocks, mimicking a glide path for a setback.
ClickGui.Style=Static: Locks in a fixed blue palette with no cycling, keeping the interface completely still.
ClickGui.Style=RainbowDelay: Cycles the whole interface through a rainbow, offsetting each element's hue by the delay.
ClickGui.Style=SimpleRainbow: Turns the primary and active colors into a direct rainbow cycle that flows over time.
ClickGui.Style=Spectrum: Lays a spectrum gradient down the screen so the color shifts continuously from top to bottom.
ClickGui.Style=Pulse: Breathes back and forth between two colors at the configured speed and count.
ClientSetting.Style=Mio: Toggle notices use a green plus or red minus prefix followed by the module name, one clean line.
ClientSetting.Style=Debug: Prints notices as category.module.enable or disable, a debug-style line for reading logs.
ClientSetting.Style=Lowercase: Writes notices entirely in lowercase, like aura enabled, for a discreet look.
ClientSetting.Style=Normal: Shows the plain module name plus Enabled or Disabled in white.
ClientSetting.Style=Future: Uses a grey module name with toggled on or off, close to the Future client style.
ClientSetting.Style=Earth: Bolds the module name and ends with a period so the notice stands out.
ClientSetting.Style=Moon: Prefixes the notice with bracketed hack and module names in the Moon client style.
ClientSetting.Style=Melon: Paints the module name cyan and ends the line with Enabled followed by a period.
ClientSetting.Style=Chinese: Announces toggles in Chinese as on or off for a localized interface.
ClientSetting.Style=None: Sends no toggle message at all, keeping chat completely silent.
Fonts.Style=PLAIN: Keeps glyphs in their original weight and slant with no extra styling.
Fonts.Style=BOLD: Renders interface text with noticeably heavier, bolder strokes.
Fonts.Style=ITALIC: Slants all interface text to one side for an italic look.
Aura.Swing=All: Plays the swing locally and sends the packet too, so others see you swing.
Aura.Swing=Client: Plays the animation only on your client and sends nothing, so others see no swing.
Aura.Swing=Server: Sends only the swing packet, so you see no animation while the server does.
Aura.Swing=None: Neither sends the packet nor plays the animation, attacking completely silently.
AutoAnchor.Swing=All: Swings locally and sends the packet on place or detonate, matching the server side.
AutoAnchor.Swing=Client: Swings only on your client, so the server receives no swing packet.
AutoAnchor.Swing=Server: Sends only the packet so the server records a swing while your hand stays still.
AutoAnchor.Swing=None: Sends no packet and shows no animation for either placing or detonating.
MaceAura.Swing=All: Swings both hands on each attack, making the motion more obvious.
MaceAura.Swing=MainHand: Swings only the main hand on each attack and leaves the offhand still.
AutoPearl.Swing=All: Swings locally and sends the packet when throwing a pearl, keeping it visible.
AutoPearl.Swing=Client: Swings only on your client when throwing, so others never see the motion.
AutoPearl.Swing=Server: Sends only the swing packet when throwing, with no local animation.
AutoPearl.Swing=None: Throws with no swing at all, sending neither animation nor packet.
AutoEZ.Type=Bot: Picks a random line from the built-in bot taunts and appends the victim's name.
AutoEZ.Type=Custom: Sends your own template, replacing the player placeholder with the victim's name.
AutoEZ.Type=AutoSex: Picks a random cutesy taunt from the built-in list and tags the victim's name.
PacketFly.Type=Down: Offsets the out-of-bounds packet 1337 blocks downward, faking a spot deep below you.
PacketFly.Type=Up: Offsets the out-of-bounds packet 1337 blocks upward, escaping checks with a high fake spot.
PacketFly.Type=Preserve: Throws the out-of-bounds packet to random far horizontal coordinates, making the offset unpredictable.
PacketFly.Type=Switch: Randomly flips the out-of-bounds offset up or down each time, constantly changing the fake spot.
PacketFly.Type=X: Shifts the out-of-bounds packet only along X, flinging the fake spot far east or west.
PacketFly.Type=Z: Shifts the out-of-bounds packet only along Z, flinging the fake spot far north or south.
PacketFly.Type=XZ: Offsets both X and Z at once, throwing the fake spot to a far diagonal corner.
Colors.ColorMode=Custom: Sticks to one fixed color and stops cycling, keeping every element on the same tone.
Colors.ColorMode=Rainbow: Cycles hues at the configured speed and saturation, letting colors flow continuously.
HUD.ColorMode=Custom: Uses the color you picked, keeping the text still without shifting.
HUD.ColorMode=Pulse: Pulses between the main and second colors for a breathing effect.
HUD.ColorMode=Rainbow: Cycles a rainbow with the set speed and delay, offsetting elements from each other.
ItemCounter.ColorMode=Custom: Draws the totem and crystal counts in fixed colors with no gradient.
ItemCounter.ColorMode=Pulse: Pulses the counts between two colors while offsetting the two entries' phases.
AntiAnchor.Page=General: The placing page with delay, blocks per tick, range and packet options.
AntiAnchor.Page=Check: The check page with self-damage threshold, enemy filter, target range and sticky fill.
AntiAnchor.Page=Rotate: The rotation page with turn toggles, yaw step size and field-of-view limits.
AntiAnchor.Page=Render: The render page holding the box and fill colors along with their toggles.
CrystalHurtPeople.Page=Combat: The combat page with target range, place rate, damage checks and auto attack.
CrystalHurtPeople.Page=Misc: The misc page with swap mode, update delay, pauses and movement prediction.
CrystalHurtPeople.Page=Render: The render page with box, fill, damage numbers and fade animation.
AntiWeak.SwapMode=Normal: Switches your hotbar to a sword and resends the attack, staying on that slot.
AntiWeak.SwapMode=Silent: Briefly switches to a sword, resends the attack, then snaps back so it looks unchanged.
AntiWeak.SwapMode=Inventory: Swaps a sword in with inventory clicks, resends the attack, then swaps back and syncs.
Offhand.SwapMode=ClickSlot: Moves the item into your offhand with three slot clicks, actually shifting it client-side.
Offhand.SwapMode=OffhandSwap: Uses a single hotbar swap action to move the item straight into your offhand.
Offhand.SwapMode=Pick: Swaps by sending pick-to-offhand packets, leaving your local inventory untouched.
AutoArrow.TargetMode=DISTANCE: Locks onto the closest player within range as the shooting target.
AutoArrow.TargetMode=HEALTH: Locks onto the player with the lowest health to finish off wounded targets.
AutoTrap.TargetMode=Single: Traps only the closest enemy in range and stops after that.
AutoTrap.TargetMode=Multi: Wraps every enemy in range one after another, trapping the whole group at once.
PacketMine.WaitPlace: Pause mining while AutoCrystal is about to place a crystal next to the mined block, then continue. Turning it off keeps mining and destroys the fresh crystal.
PistonCrystalPlus.TargetRange: Search range for enemies in blocks.
PistonCrystalPlus.Range: Operating range for placing and breaking; crystal spots are searched inside it too.
PistonCrystalPlus.MinDamage: Minimum estimated damage to the target before running the combo.
PistonCrystalPlus.MaxSelfDamage: Maximum self damage allowed, otherwise the spot is skipped.
PistonCrystalPlus.OnlyMain: Only pause when the main hand is eating or using an item.
PistonCrystalPlus.PreferCrystal: Yield to AutoCrystal while it is working on a crystal.
PistonCrystalPlus.PacketPlace: Place blocks with packets instead of vanilla interaction.
PistonCrystalPlus.YawDeceive: Aim along the push direction while placing the piston so its facing is correct.
PistonCrystalPlus.RedStone: Redstone mode: block power or torch.
PistonCrystalPlus.RenderBox: Draw boxes for planned crystal, piston and redstone positions.
PistonCrystalPlus.Delay: Minimum delay in milliseconds between combo actions.
PistonCrystalPlus.BreakDelay: Minimum wait in milliseconds before breaking an existing crystal.
PistonCrystalPlus.Mine: Packet-mine a piston that blocks the crystal spot.
PistonCrystalPlus.NoSuicide: Skip a spot if the self damage would kill you.
PistonCrystalPlus.InventorySwap: Use items from the inventory silently.
PistonCrystalPlus.UsingPause: Pause the combo while eating or using an item.
PistonCrystalPlus.Crystal: Color of the planned crystal box.
PistonCrystalPlus.Piston: Color of the planned piston box.
PistonCrystalPlus.Redstone: Color of the planned redstone box.
SelfTrap.PreExplosion: Re-place right when an explosion packet arrives instead of waiting for the next poll.
SelfTrap.PreCrystal: Re-place right when a crystal spawns nearby, before it can blow the surround open.
SelfTrap.PreBroke: Re-place immediately when a surround block is broken (block update packet).
SelfTrap.CrystalProtect: Break crystals around the placed block so the surround cannot be blown open.
SelfTrap.Trap: Adds another layer above the blocks next to you, so crystals or anchors cannot be placed from above.
SelfTrap.TrapExtend: Whether the Trap layer keeps expanding: Off = one layer only, Mining = only where the target is mining, Always = unconditional.
SelfTrap.Extend: Whether to keep surrounding beyond the blocks you are touching: Off = inner ring only, Mining = only where the target is mining, Always = unconditional.
SelfTrap.Support: How many levels to search downward for a support when the target has no reachable face: 0 = one neighbour only (old behaviour), 2-3 forces blocks into floating gaps.
SelfTrap.CrawlHead: Also seal your head while crawling. Crawling is only 0.6 blocks tall, so it seals the block above your feet.
AutoPush.OutOfBlock: Only push targets that are actually stuck (burrow/surround): find an unblocked exit, then place the piston on the opposite side. Turning it off falls back to wall-pushing only.
AutoPush.Consecutive: Keep the module enabled after a successful push and keep pushing at the Delay interval; AutoDisable is ignored while this is on.
AutoPush.Merge: Prefer directions that squeeze several enemies into the same cell, so one trap catches all of them.
AutoPush.BreakCrystal: Break crystals around the target before pushing, so you don't eat the explosion yourself.
AutoPush.IgnoreNakeds: Skip players wearing no armor at all.
AutoPush.BreakRange: Search radius (blocks) for the crystals cleared before pushing.
AutoPush.AutoDisable: Disable the module after one successful push (saves blocks). Ignored while Consecutive is on.
CrystalBot.Thread: Run target scanning on a background thread; the main thread only consumes the result. Scanning is what makes this module heavy (a full sphere sweep plus many explosion raycasts every PosUpdateDelay), so enabling this removes the frame drops.
KillEffect.Mode: Effect type: Default (lightning + sounds), Picture (ring + arrows), LightPillar.
KillEffect.Mode=Default: Default: spawn lightning at the corpse, optionally with level-up / trident sounds and kill-streak sounds.
KillEffect.Mode=Picture: Picture: draw a camera-facing ring and arrows at the kill position, then fade out.
KillEffect.Mode=LightPillar: LightPillar: raise a white pillar at the kill position that shrinks and fades.
KillEffect.Factor: How many times lightning and sounds repeat in Default mode.
KillEffect.Duration: How long the picture effect stays on the kill position, in seconds.
KillEffect.Scale: Scale of the ring and arrows.
KillEffect.Flash: Blink the picture effect every 200ms; turn off to keep it always visible.
KillEffect.PillarDuration: Seconds for the pillar to shrink and fade out completely.
KillEffect.PillarWidth: Pillar width at the bottom (blocks); it shrinks to 0 over time.
KillEffect.PillarAlpha: Bottom opacity of the pillar; the top fades to 30%.
KillEffect.StreakSound: Play an escalating kill sound based on the streak (1-5, capped at the 5th).
KillEffect.StreakReset: Seconds without a kill before the streak counter resets.
Surround.Support: How many blocks below to chain-place when there is no supporting face (0 = only place against existing blocks).
Surround.Center: Move back to the center of the block you stand on; Move uses movement instead of position packets, so only 4 faces need sealing instead of 2-4 blocks' worth.
Surround.BreakCrystal: Pops a crystal already sitting on the target position before placing, so the block is not blocked.
Surround.CrystalProtect: Clears crystals around the placed block afterwards, so a fresh enemy crystal cannot pop you out.
Surround.FOV: With OnlyLooking on, a face is only used when it falls inside this angle.
*.Explosions: Pre-place blocks the moment an explosion happens.
*.Spawn: Pre-place blocks where an end crystal spawns.
*.Broke: Refill a surround position the moment it breaks.
*.StandHead: Also trap the block above your head while standing.
*.CrawlHead: Also trap the block above your head while crawling.
*.BPT: Max blocks placed per tick. Lower is safer, higher is faster.
*.SwapAction: How to get the block in hand: Screen uses inventory clicks, Hotbar switches hotbar slot.
*.Center: When to move yourself to the block center: Never / OnActivate / Always (teleports) / Move (walk back without position packets).
*.Protect: Break nearby crystals after placing to keep the surround intact.
*.BreakCrystal: Break crystals inside the target block before placing.
*.AssumeBreak: Treat a block that is almost mined as already gone and place into it early.
*.BreakTime: How long a block must be mined before it counts as broken (seconds).
*.Support: How many helper blocks may be placed when the surround is floating.
*.Multi: When several positions float at once, build every support chain or only the shortest.
*.Trap: Also seal the layer above you.
*.GroundOnly: Only works while standing on a block.
*.DisableOnYDiff: Disable when your Y level rises.
*.FOV: Max view offset allowed while rotating (degrees).
*.GodMode: Assume a block being mined is already gone and place into it.
*.FailedSkip: Ignore break records already marked as failed.
*.HeadKey: While held, only seal the block above your head.
*.NoBlockDisable: Disable when no usable block is found.
*.MoveDisable: Disable after moving too far from the start position.
*.PreExplosion: Instantly re-surround when an explosion packet arrives.
*.PreCrystal: Instantly re-surround when a crystal spawns.
*.PreBroke: Instantly refill a surround position when it breaks.
Surround.Timing: Packet pre-place timing: Vanilla only scans on tick, Sequential also handles explosion/crystal/break packets on the main thread.
Surround.Explosions: Surround yourself the moment an explosion happens.
Surround.Spawn: Seal the spot the moment a crystal spawns. This is the most effective anti-place.
Surround.Broke: Refill the surround the instant it breaks.
Surround.Surround: Seal the four sides of the blocks you stand on.
Surround.StandHead: Also seal the block above your head while standing.
Surround.CrawlHead: Also seal the block above your head while crawling.
Surround.MineDownward: Do not refill the block you are mining downwards.
Surround.EnderChest: Fall back to ender chests when out of obsidian.
Surround.Delay: Ticks between placements. Higher is safer.
Surround.BPT: Max blocks per tick. 1-2 recommended for surround.
Surround.SwapAction: Hotbar is fastest; Screen uses inventory clicks.
Surround.Rotate: Automatically look at the clicked face.
Surround.Protect: Break nearby crystals after placing to keep the surround intact.
Surround.AssumeBreak: Treat a surround block being mined as already gone and refill it early.
Surround.BreakTime: How long a block must be mined before it counts as broken (seconds).
Surround.AirPlace: Allow placing blocks in mid air.
Surround.Multi: Build every support chain or only the shortest.
Surround.Extend: Extend the surround outwards while it is being mined.
Surround.GroundOnly: Only works while standing on a block.
Surround.DisableOnYDiff: Disable when your Y level rises.
Surround.YawStep: Rotate in steps to avoid instant snap flags.
Surround.OnlyLooking: Only place when the face is already in view.
AutoMine.Selection: How the block lists are used: All ignores them, Whitelist only mines listed blocks, Blacklist mines everything else.
AutoMine.Whitelist: Blocks allowed to be mined (used when Selection is Whitelist).
AutoMine.Blacklist: Blocks never mined (used when Selection is Blacklist).
AutoMine.TargetRange: Max distance to search for target players.
AutoMine.MineRange: Max distance a block may be to be mined.
AutoMine.Sort: Ordering when several targets are in range. Default picks the one closest to your view.
AutoMine.Wait: Wait while the previously submitted block is still being mined.
AutoMine.Burrow: Mine the four corners under the target to push them out of the block.
AutoMine.Face: Mine the blocks around the target's head level (y+1.5).
AutoMine.Surround: Mine the target's surround so a crystal can finish them.
AutoMine.CheckSelf: Skip blocks that would block you while your own footing is unstable.
AutoMine.FriendSync: Skip blocks a friend is currently mining.
AutoMine.Priority: Above 0 submits two blocks at once (second closest first, closest next tick); 0 mines only one.
AutoMine.Selection=All: Ignore both lists and mine anything in range.
AutoMine.Selection=Whitelist: Only mine blocks listed in the whitelist.
AutoMine.Selection=Blacklist: Mine everything except blocks in the blacklist.
AutoMine.Sort=LowestHealth: Pick the player with the lowest health.
AutoMine.Sort=HighestHealth: Pick the player with the highest health.
AutoMine.Sort=ClosestAngle: Pick the player closest to your current view angle.
AutoAnchor.PreferCrystal: Step aside while AutoCrystal is placing a crystal.
*.BlockList: Block multi-select: right-click to expand, click a row to toggle, Shift+left-click to reset. The first row is a search box, the last row pages through the list.
AutoMine.CevPause: Pause mining while CevBreaker is on, leaving the ground for the crystal headshot instead of breaking the base yourself.
AutoMine.Dynamic: Dynamic packet mine: every DynamicInterval ms recompute which block should be mined at the target position — if it is already being mined, keep it; otherwise abort the current one (ABORT to the server) and switch to it. Occupying any one of the four surround sides is enough; never bounce between them. Off = vanilla hysteresis behaviour.
AutoMine.DynamicInterval: How often to re-evaluate the target, in milliseconds. Smaller follows tighter; ticks outside the interval never interrupt ongoing mining.
AutoMine.ForceDouble: Keep the double-mine strict: when on, no third target is picked until the secondary one is done; when off, the target may change every tick.
AutoTrap.PacketRepair: Refill a broken trap spot in the same tick it was mined, instead of waiting for the next Delay. The best answer to instant mining.
HUD.PotionsIcon: Show status icons (speed, resistance, ...) in the potion list. Off = text only, narrower.
Surround.Burst: Burst: when the ring has 3+ gaps, ignore the blocks-per-tick limit and fill them all at once (up to 6). Walls you in faster on the first pass, at the cost of a short burst of interact packets.
SelfTrap.Burst: Burst: when the ring has 3+ gaps, ignore the blocks-per-tick limit and fill them all at once (up to 6). Walls you in faster on the first pass, at the cost of a short burst of interact packets.
AntiCrawl.While=Crawling: Only work while actually crawling (head pinned to a 1-block gap), so it costs no packets the rest of the time.
AntiCrawl.While=Mining: Work while crawling, and also while mining the block you are standing on - that briefly removes your footing.
AntiCrawl.While=Always: Keep working whenever the block below is not bedrock. Most reliable, but constantly sends interacts.
PistonCrystalPlus.RedStone=Torch: Trigger the piston with a redstone torch; powered the moment it is placed.
PistonCrystalPlus.RedStone=Block: Trigger the piston with a redstone block; sticks to walls and survives being pushed.
ChunkESP.DetectMode=Normal: Plain detection: mark newly appearing chunks as suspect, may include fake updates caused by Block Exploit.
ChunkESP.DetectMode=IgnoreBlockExploit: Ignore fake block updates from Block Exploit - fewer hits, fewer false positives.
ChunkESP.DetectMode=BlockExploitMode: Detect Block Exploit itself; most accurate when paired with BlockUpdateExploit.
SkinFlicker.Mode=Random: Every model part toggles randomly on its own - the messiest flicker.
SkinFlicker.Mode=Switch: Flip every enabled part to off (and back), so the whole skin blinks together.
SkinFlicker.Mode=Sync: All parts share one state, so the entire skin flickers in sync.
AutoWalk.Mode=Forward: Walk straight along your current view direction; turning changes the heading.
AutoWalk.Mode=Path: Follow the configured path points, handling drops and turns on its own.
Sorter.TrashMode=Whitelist: Only drop what is on the list; keep everything else.
Sorter.TrashMode=Blacklist: Drop everything except what is on the list.
ServerLagger.Mode=AAC: Payload aimed at the AAC anticheat.
ServerLagger.Mode=AAC2: Second AAC payload with a different trigger; use it when the first does nothing.
ServerLagger.Mode=Armor: Repeatedly equip and unequip armor to flood equipment sync.
ServerLagger.Mode=Chunk: Request chunk data far away from you.
ServerLagger.Mode=InteractNoCom: Interact packets with no coordinates (all zero).
ServerLagger.Mode=InteractOOB: Interact coordinates outside the world border.
ServerLagger.Mode=InvalidClickSlot: Click a slot id that does not exist.
AntiCrawl.While: When anti-crawl actually works: only then does it block the block above your head and keep you from being pinned into crawling.
ChunkESP.DetectMode: Chunk detection mode: how new chunks are told apart from your own forged block updates, so fake signals are not counted as real ones.
Sorter.TrashMode: Which way the trash list works: drop only what is listed, or drop everything except what is listed.
FakeFlight.UpdateMode: Which part of the tick runs the main logic (start flying, hover, climb and descend).
FakeFlight.UpdateMode=All: Runs both before and after the move packet: snappiest, but also the most obvious jump in position.
FakeFlight.UpdateMode=Pre: Runs only before the move packet, so your position matches what the server sees.
FakeFlight.UpdateMode=Post: Runs only after the move packet - fine once the hover is stable.
FakeFlight.UpdateModeControl: Which part of the tick sends position packets while you steer with WASD.
FakeFlight.UpdateModeControl=All: Both sides: steering and movement feel tightest, at the cost of more packets.
FakeFlight.UpdateModeControl=Pre: Before the move packet - cleanest position.
FakeFlight.UpdateModeControl=Post: After the move packet - smoother transitions, occasionally one tick late.
AntiCheat.LimitActions: Global interaction budget. Every module (Surround, SelfTrap, AutoTrap, AutoAnchor, AutoCrystal) shares one 'max placements per 50ms' allowance; anything over it is dropped and retried next tick. This is what gets most people kicked - do not turn it off unless you know what you are doing.
AntiCheat.ActionLimit: Max placements / block clicks per 50ms. 3 is roughly 60 interactions per second, already close to a human ceiling; higher is more aggressive and more likely to trip packet checks.
AntiCheat.RotationLimit: Max instant look packets per 50ms. A placement has to aim first; too low slows Surround and anchor insertion, too high means several head snaps per tick - which stands out more than the interact packets themselves.
CrystalBot.Page: Pages: place / break / base / rotation / ray-trace / prediction / misc / render.
CrystalBot.PlaceDelay: Minimum interval between crystal placements in milliseconds. Lower is more aggressive and easier to flag.
CrystalBot.PlaceMode: Placement mode: Weak = only when damage is enough; Strong = keep a crystal on that spot; Instant = ignore the delay.
CrystalBot.AutoSwap: How to get a crystal in hand: Normal = hotbar switch; Silent = slot packet only, no view change; Inventory = swap straight from the inventory.
CrystalBot.SilentMode: Silent swap method: normal slot switch / inventory swap / pick from inventory.
CrystalBot.PlaceRange: Max distance for placing, measured to the base block.
CrystalBot.MinPDamage: Skip spots that would deal less than this to the enemy.
CrystalBot.MaxSelfDmg: Skip spots that would deal more than this to you.
CrystalBot.Reserve: Health you want to keep: skip when self damage + reserve exceeds your current HP.
CrystalBot.FacePlace: Force a placement when the target health or armor durability is below the threshold.
CrystalBot.FacePlaceHealth: Target health that triggers face place.
CrystalBot.FacePlaceArmor: Target armor durability percentage that triggers face place.
CrystalBot.BreakDelay: Minimum interval between crystal attacks in milliseconds.
CrystalBot.ExplodeMode: Explosion rhythm: normal / sync with placement / both / one at a time.
CrystalBot.Remove: Remove the crystal entity locally after attacking instead of waiting for the server. Visual only.
CrystalBot.BreakFactor: How many attack packets per explosion. Multiple packets bypass some single-packet damage caps but get flagged more often.
CrystalBot.InstantBreak: Attack a crystal as soon as it appears, ignoring BreakDelay.
CrystalBot.SyncWeb: Clear the cobweb under your feet while exploding.
CrystalBot.BasePlace: Automatically place obsidian bases for crystals.
CrystalBot.BaseDelay: Minimum interval between base placements in milliseconds.
CrystalBot.BaseMin: Minimum damage a base placement must be able to deal.
CrystalBot.BaseMax: Maximum self damage accepted for a base placement.
CrystalBot.OverrideMax: Give up the base placement when self damage exceeds this stricter limit.
CrystalBot.BaseBalance: Compare enemy and self damage before placing a base.
CrystalBot.OnlyBelow: Only place bases below your feet.
CrystalBot.InventorySwap: Take obsidian straight from the inventory instead of the hotbar.
CrystalBot.DetectMining: Do not place a base on a block that someone is mining.
CrystalBot.OnPlace: Rotate toward the base block when placing.
CrystalBot.OnBreak: Rotate toward the crystal when attacking.
CrystalBot.RotationBypass: Rotation bypass: expanded hitbox / point / placement angle. Off uses the vanilla raycast.
CrystalBot.HitboxExpand: How much to expand the hitbox for the rotation check.
CrystalBot.PlaceTWall: Allow placing through walls even when the raycast fails.
CrystalBot.MultiPoint: Density of the multi-point raycast. Denser places more reliably on edges and through walls, at the cost of more packets.
CrystalBot.Predict: Predict target positions from their motion before calculating damage.
CrystalBot.PredictTicks: How many ticks ahead to predict.
CrystalBot.MaxMotionXZ: Max horizontal blocks per tick used by the prediction.
CrystalBot.MaxMotionY: Max vertical blocks per tick used by the prediction.
CrystalBot.SelfPredict: Use your predicted position for self damage too.
CrystalBot.AutoPredict: Adjust prediction ticks automatically from ping and motion.
CrystalBot.UsingPause: Pause the aura while eating or drinking.
CrystalBot.GuiPause: Pause while any screen is open.
CrystalBot.RegearPause: Pause while the regear module is working.
CrystalBot.PushPause: Pause while the push module is working.
CrystalBot.PlacePosMode: Target position mode: single = one best spot; double = keep two candidates and alternate.
CrystalBot.PosUpdateDelay: Interval for recalculating the target position in milliseconds. Lower reacts faster and costs more CPU.
CrystalBot.WallRange: Distance allowed when the target is behind a wall.
CrystalBot.Balance: Balance between multiple targets by health instead of focusing a single one.
CrystalBot.BalanceOffset: Health offset used by balancing; positive favors healthier targets.
CrystalBot.SurroundFucker: Breaks the obsidian ring around the target feet with packet mine so crystals can be placed right against the feet.
CrystalBot.SurroundDelay: Delay between surround-break attempts. Too low keeps packet mine busy and starves other mining links.
CrystalBot.Shrink: Play a shrink animation when the spot changes.
CrystalBot.SliderSpeed: Animation speed when the spot moves.
CrystalBot.StartFade: Fade-in time for a new spot in seconds.
CrystalBot.FadeSpeed: Fade-out speed when a spot disappears.
CrystalBot.DamageText: Show the predicted damage above the spot.
CrystalBot.ItemSpoof: Client-side visual spoof of the held item.
CrystalBot.ForcePlace: Force placement: skip the base block check. For ghost blocks and desync; leave it off normally.

CrystalBot.Page=RayTrace: Ray-trace page: through-wall placement and multi-point rays.
CrystalBot.Page=Prediction: Prediction page: motion prediction for the target and yourself.

CrystalBot.ExplodeMode=Sync: Sync: explode in sync with your own placement.
CrystalBot.ExplodeMode=Both: Both: use both rhythms, whatever can fire first.
CrystalBot.ExplodeMode=Sequential: Sequential: attack one crystal at a time instead of concurrently.
CrystalBot.PlacePosMode=Double: Double: lock two candidates and alternate.
CrystalBot.AutoSwap=None: None: only use crystals already in hand or offhand.
CrystalBot.AutoSwap=Silent: Silent: send the slot packet without changing your view.
CrystalBot.AutoSwap=Inventory: Inventory: move a crystal from the inventory into your hand.
CrystalBot.SilentMode=Normal: Normal: switch the hotbar slot directly.
CrystalBot.SilentMode=Alternative: Alternative: swap the inventory slot with the selected slot.
CrystalBot.SilentMode=Pick: Pick: pull the crystal from the inventory with a pick packet.
CrystalBot.MultiPoint=X8: 8 points: eight rays, places even on the hardest spots.
CrystalBot.RotationBypass=Off: Off: use the vanilla raycast check.
CrystalBot.RotationBypass=ExtraHitbox: Extra hitbox: expand the hitbox before computing rotation.
CrystalBot.RotationBypass=Point: Point: aim at a fixed point on the block.
CrystalBot.RotationBypass=PlaceAngle: Place angle: compute rotation from the placement face.
CrystalBot.SpoofMode=Totem: Spoof as a totem of undying.

AutoCrystal.InventorySwap: Swap items through the inventory instead of hotbar packets.
